name: pa-server
description: PA (People Analytics Service) 应用服务：分析、呈现、报告与导出，经 MCP 工具面与控制台交付，包 Cube REST API

scripts.build: bun run clean && tsc && vite build widget && bun run build:console
scripts.build:console: vite build console && vite build console --mode dashboard
scripts.format: biome format --write src result_view/src widget/src widget/vite.config.ts console/src console/vite.config.ts scripts && uvx ruff==0.15.22 format --config ../ruff.toml ../demo ../scripts
scripts.format:check: biome format src result_view/src widget/src widget/vite.config.ts console/src console/vite.config.ts scripts && uvx ruff==0.15.22 format --check --config ../ruff.toml ../demo ../scripts
scripts.lint:ts: biome lint --error-on-warnings src result_view/src widget/src widget/vite.config.ts console/src console/vite.config.ts scripts
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ts && bun run lint:python && bun run lint:shell
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p result_view --noEmit && tsc -p widget --noEmit && tsc -p console --noEmit && tsc -p scripts
scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p result_view/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p widget/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p console/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:tests && bun test && bun run test:python && bun run build && bun run check:open-source
